```{r}
library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)
library(quantmod)
library(fable)
library(gridExtra)

forecast = fabletools::forecast
```

```{r}
get_data_stock = function(symbol, source = "yahoo"){
  suppressWarnings({
    getSymbols(symbol, src = source)
    gold.data = fortify(get(symbol))
    gold.data <- data.frame(gold.data)
  })
  df = gold.data[,c(1,4)]
  colnames(df) = c("index", "price")
  return(df)
}

get_prev = function(data, modelo_str, param, h = 5){
  sequencia = seq(from = data[nrow(data),1], by = 1, length.out = 5)
  data = na.omit(data)
  data$index = seq(from = data[1,1], by = 1, length.out = nrow(data))
  ts_df = as_tsibble(data)
  if(modelo_str == "ARIMA"){
    modelo = ts_df %>% model(ARIMA(price ~ pdq(param[1],param[2],param[3])))
  }
  plots = feasts::gg_tsresiduals(modelo)
  prev = forecast(modelo, h = 5)
  prev = as.data.frame(prev)
  prev$index= sequencia
  prev = prev[,c(2,4)]
  colnames(prev) = c("index", "price")
  return(list(prev, plots))
}

get_graph = function(data, modelo_str, param, show = nrow(data), h = 5){
  df_to_show = data[(nrow(data)-show):nrow(data),]
  df_to_show = na.omit(df_to_show)
  
  infos = get_prev(data = data, modelo_str = modelo_str, param = param, h = h)
  prev = infos[[1]]
  plots = infos[[2]]
  
  plot <- ggplot()+
    geom_line(data = df_to_show, aes(x = index, y = price))+
    ggtitle("Preço do Ouro")+
    geom_line(data = prev, aes(x = index, y = price), color = "blue")+
    labs(x = "Data", y = "Valor de Fechamento", title = paste(modelo_str,
                                                                paste0("(",
                                                                      paste(param, collapse = ", "),
                                                                      ")"
                                                                      )
                                                                ))+
      theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 24, hjust = 0.5))
  
    plot1 = plots[[1]] + xlab("Data") + ylab("Resíduo") + labs(title = "Resíduos do Modelo") +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5))
    
    plot2 = plots[[2]] + xlab("Lag") + ylab("Autocorrelação") + labs(title = "Autocorrelação do Modelo")+
      theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5))
    
    plot3 = plots[[3]] + xlab("Resíduo") + ylab("Contagem") + labs(title = "Histograma dos Resíduos")+
      theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5))
    
    plot_grid = grid.arrange(arrangeGrob(plot, ncol = 1),
                             arrangeGrob(plot1, plot2, plot3, ncol = 3),
                             ncol = 1)
    
    return(plot_grid)
}
```

```{r}
df = get_data_stock("GC=F")
prev = get_prev(df, modelo_str = "ARIMA", param = c(1,1,1), h = 5)
get_graph(df, "ARIMA", c(1,1,1), show = 100, h = 5)
#get_diag(df, modelo_str = "ARIMA", param = c(1,1,1), h = 5)
```

```{r}
ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Comparação de modelos para a previsão do valor do ouro"),

  sliderInput(inputId = "slider_modelos",
              label = "Escolha um modelo:",
              min = 1, max = 3, value = 1),
  
  sliderInput(inputId = "slider_obs",
              label = "Escolha o tamanho da série temporal:",
              min = 1, max = 100, value = 20),
  
  plotOutput("plot_pred")
)
```

```{r}
server <- function(input, output, session) {
  get_data_stock = function(symbol, source = "yahoo"){
    suppressWarnings({
      getSymbols(symbol, src = source)
      gold.data = fortify(get(symbol))
      gold.data <- data.frame(gold.data)
    })
    df = gold.data[,c(1,4)]
    colnames(df) = c("index", "price")
    return(df)
  }
  
  get_prev = function(data, modelo_str, param, h = 5){
    sequencia = seq(from = data[nrow(data),1], by = 1, length.out = 5)
    data = na.omit(data)
    data$index = seq(from = data[1,1], by = 1, length.out = nrow(data))
    ts_df = as_tsibble(data)
    if(modelo_str == "ARIMA"){
      modelo = ts_df %>% model(ARIMA(price ~ pdq(param[1],param[2],param[3])))
    }
    plots = feasts::gg_tsresiduals(modelo)
    prev = forecast(modelo, h = 5)
    prev = as.data.frame(prev)
    prev$index= sequencia
    prev = prev[,c(2,4)]
    colnames(prev) = c("index", "price")
    return(list(prev, plots))
  }
  
  get_graph = function(data, modelo_str, param, show = nrow(data), h = 5){
    df_to_show = data[(nrow(data)-show):nrow(data),]
    df_to_show = na.omit(df_to_show)
    
    infos = get_prev(data = data, modelo_str = modelo_str, param = param, h = h)
    prev = infos[[1]]
    plots = infos[[2]]
    
    plot <- ggplot()+
      geom_line(data = df_to_show, aes(x = index, y = price))+
      ggtitle("Preço do Ouro")+
      geom_line(data = prev, aes(x = index, y = price), color = "blue")+
      labs(x = "Data", y = "Valor de Fechamento", title = paste(modelo_str,
                                                                  paste0("(",
                                                                        paste(param, collapse = ", "),
                                                                        ")"
                                                                        )
                                                                  ))+
        theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 24, hjust = 0.5))
    
      plot1 = plots[[1]] + xlab("Data") + ylab("Resíduo") + labs(title = "Resíduos do Modelo") +
        theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5))
      
      plot2 = plots[[2]] + xlab("Lag") + ylab("Autocorrelação") + labs(title = "Autocorrelação do Modelo")+
        theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5))
      
      plot3 = plots[[3]] + xlab("Resíduo") + ylab("Contagem") + labs(title = "Histograma dos Resíduos")+
        theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5))
      
      plot_grid = grid.arrange(arrangeGrob(plot, ncol = 1),
                               arrangeGrob(plot1, plot2, plot3, ncol = 3),
                               ncol = 1)
      
      return(plot_grid)
  }
  
  options <- c("ARIMA 1,1,1", "ARIMA 1,1,0", "ARIMA 0,1,1")
    
  observeEvent(input$slider_modelos, {
    updateTextInput(session, "modelos", value = options[input$slider_modelos])
    
  })

  modelos = c("ARIMA", "ARIMA", "ARIMA")
  parametros = list(c(1,1,1), c(1,1,0), c(0,1,1))
  
  data <- get_data_stock("GC=F")

  output$plot_pred <- renderPlot({
    modelo <- modelos[input$slider_modelos]
    param <- parametros[[input$slider_modelos]]
    show = input$slider_obs
    plots = get_graph(data, modelo, param, show, h = 5)
  })
  
}
```

```{r}
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
```
